words.meaning: the value found by adding all numerical observations and dividing by their number
words.example: The mean score increased after the course.

words.meaning: the middle value in an ordered set, or the mean of the two middle values when the count is even
words.example: The report gives the median household income.

sentencePractice.prompt: After five different values are ordered from smallest to largest, the researcher selects the third value. This method finds the ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Selecting the central ordered value is the method for finding the median; the mean uses arithmetic averaging and the mode identifies the most frequent value, even if numerical results happen to coincide.

words.meaning: the value or category that occurs most often in a set of observations
words.example: The mode was the most frequently chosen response.

words.meaning: the pattern showing how values or categories occur across a set of observations
words.example: The graph shows the distribution of test scores.

words.meaning: the extent to which observations differ from one another
words.example: The second group showed greater variability in completion time.

words.meaning: a numerical measure of how spread out values are around their mean
words.example: The table reports the mean and standard deviation for each group.

words.meaning: the size of a part divided by the size of the whole
words.example: The proportion of participants who completed the task was higher this year.

words.meaning: an approximate value for an unknown quantity based on available information
words.example: The sample provided an estimate of average study time.

words.meaning: a test result meeting a chosen cutoff for evidence against a stated starting assumption
words.example: The authors reported statistical significance alongside the size of the difference.
words.usageNote: 検定の前提が成り立つ条件で、帰無仮説に対する所定の基準を満たすことです。効果の大きさ、実用上の重要性、仮説が正しい確率は示しません。

words.meaning: a numerical measure of the magnitude of a difference or relationship
words.example: The effect size describes how large the observed difference was.

sentencePractice.prompt: The authors report how large the difference between the groups is, rather than whether it crosses a testing threshold. They report the ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Magnitude of a difference identifies effect size; statistical significance concerns a threshold and a sample is the set studied.
